items.title: Regeneron (REGN) Stock Still Looks Undervalued After A 40% Run
items.summary: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals has delivered a strong share price run over the past year, which puts a spotlight on whether the current US$801.82 level is still grounded in what the business earns today. With the focus squarely on profits and the P/E discussion around them, the question is how much of that recent strength can be explained by earnings power rather than sentiment alone.
